recommendations.description: Fix credential handling and path validation vulnerabilities in main.ts. Credentials must be cleared from memory after use, and report output paths must be validated to prevent directory traversal attacks.
Implement comprehensive test suite for error-handler.ts covering exponential backoff calculation, timeout cleanup, and retry exhaustion. These critical utilities currently have 0% coverage.
Add integration tests for CLI workflow and authentication methods. Main.ts has 0% coverage with 2 critical test gaps that could cause silent failures.
Add timeout handling and circuit breaker pattern to orchestrator.ts. Currently lacks mechanisms to prevent hanging operations when coordinating multiple agents.
Implement comprehensive unit tests for rate-limiter.ts focusing on sliding window calculation and concurrent request handling.
Extract validation logic in orchestrator.ts into separate Strategy pattern implementation.
Extract sequential validation steps in main.ts into separate functions.
Implement pagination for large GitHub PRs in orchestrator.ts.
Extract sliding window algorithm in rate-limiter.ts into focused helper methods.
Replace exponential backoff calculation in error-handler.ts with bounded calculation and add jitter.
